From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Subject: Pilot qualification: recommended inference slate + TPS/latency links

Hi Alice / Bob — great conversation today. Quick post-call recap and our proposed next steps for the pilot (two-week smoke test focused on intent extraction + reranking):

Summary / recommended inference slate
- Shortlist: redwood/titan-7b-quant (v2-int8) and open/opt-13b-int8 (compat fallback)
- Canonical routes: intent-extract (short inputs), rerank (longer context up to 2k tokens)

Redwood-verified performance highlights (measured on 1x A100 equiv):
- redwood/titan-7b-quant (v2-int8): baseline TPS 75 req/s, p50 = 18 ms, p90 = 45 ms, p99 = 120 ms
- open/opt-13b-int8: baseline TPS 22 req/s, p50 = 42 ms, p90 = 110 ms, p99 = 310 ms
(These are the profiles we saw during the call — detailed traces linked below.)

Quality & regression notes
- We saw occasional token-level drift on long multi-turn rerank prompts in the 7b quantized variant; we recommend a prompt-smoke set focused on hallucination-sensitive prompts (attached: prompt-pack-v1.zip).
- Regression guard: we suggest a small holdout eval (100 examples) run before and after any quantization change. We can run Redwood's eval harness and attach the diff report.

Attachments & links
- hearth-pilot-benchlinks.md — contains Redwood perf-profile links, trace snippets, and sample curl commands (attached).
- prompt-pack-v1.zip — set of 25 prompt variations and expected answer checks for regression monitoring.
- Quick perf profile (hosted): https://redwood.ai/perf-profiles/hearthai-pilot-20261012

Next steps / ask
1) Confirm pilot scope (intent-extract + rerank) and target SLOs (we'll assume p95 latency <= 150 ms for intent routes; please confirm).
2) Can you share an expected steady-state QPS and peak burst QPS for the two-week run? We'll map that to Dedicated vs Hosted routing options and give cost ranges.
3) If OK, we'll queue a short runbook and produce preliminary p95/p99 traces for both models (deliverable: bench-trace-20261014.csv) — cc'ing Aditya to own the benchmark runs.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute follow-up if you'd like a walk-through of the traces.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Logan — very helpful recap. A few quick clarifications before we lock scope: 

1) p99 numbers look high for opt-13b-int8 at 310ms — is that for single-token microbench or for 2k-token rerank paths? If it's the latter, can you share p99-by-seq-length?
2) For the proposed p95 <= 150ms SLO on intent routes: does that assume continuous prefix caching and batching enabled? What will SLO look like without caching?
3) We're curious about canarying this on Dedicated capacity (we have procurement questions). Can Redwood run a short canary with gradual traffic shift and throttled fallback to hosted? Any template for the mutual action plan / procurement checklist?

Also please attach the performance trace CSV (bench-trace-20261014.csv) and the short cost delta estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted at 10/100/1000 QPS.

Appreciate it — Alice
Alice Park
Head of Product, HearthAI
